description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Estaciones de Aforo en embalse SAIH is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. The WMS Service (Web Map Service) called SAIH Reservoir Capacity Stations allows the visualization and consultation of the Control Points of the Automatic Hydrological Information System (SAIH). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) SAIH Reservoir Capacity Stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
